transcription: orig/benzecri1960_ch1.tex is a TRANSCRIPTION, not the author's source: no LaTeX source of the paper exists. It was made on 2026-11-03 by a Claude session (WP-45) from the page images of the scan, the OCR layer used only as a help, and is to be checked by the author. Scope: the results A, B, C of the introduction (journal pp. 230-231) and Chapter 1 complete (pp. 233-246). Misprints are kept and flagged `% [sic]`; the \bzcf cross-reference macro and the end of each environment are editorial, as the file's header says. Re-snapshot 2026-11-03 (DEC-122): the p. 238 sentence on the universal cover of a compact locally projective manifold is wrapped in an editorial enonce environment so that it carries its own ledger row; no word of the text changed.
